data.gender_notes: Amanat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amanat is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amara’, meaning ‘immortal’. It is a name of great spiritual significance in Hindu tradition, symbolizing the eternal nature of the soul and the quest for enlightenment. The name Amanat carries the meaning “Immortal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amanat usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the eternal and divine nature of the soul.
data.etymology: Amanat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amanat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Amanat carries deep spiritual significance as it resonates with the Hindu belief in the immortality of the soul. The name reminds the bearer of their eternal nature and the importance of living a virtuous and righteous life in pursuit of enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Amanat symbolizes endless giving and selfless service to others. The name derives from the Sanskrit word 'amanat', meaning 'without desire or expectation of reward'. Amanat embodies the spirit of generosity and compassion, inspiring those around them to follow a similar path of giving.
